items.html: And you already know that in the Yesod of Ima is clothed the Daat of ZA, which includes the five Hassadim and the five Gevurot, in the secret of the five pure bloods and the five impure bloods. For in the Yesod of Ima there are ten aspects of garments, to clothe the five Hassadim and the five Gevurot; and the garments are in the secret of the posterior of Ehyeh, in the secret of the blood of man, at the time that ZA is in her, in the secret of the first Ibur, which the name Ehyeh indicates there, as mentioned in the Zohar, Parashat Acharei Mot, page 65b: “Ehyeh, for I am ready to give birth,” etc.
